source.original_authority_levels: Moreyra S1 = BioSample/voucher/SRR metadata; U/D = independent botanical species/variety concept, not directly observed sequenced specimens

original_state_taxon_assignment_gate.source_taxon_concept_grouping: Original binomial plus var. epithet when present; authorship omitted; never coerce named varieties to species.

morphology_blind_null.method: 20,000 exact-source U/D label permutations over 27 independent taxon-concept blocks (not 28 phenotyped specimen labels), group-level U/D counts maintained within Japan, North America and West Palearctic; unscored specimens/varieties stay missing; fixed molecular topology.
morphology_blind_null.inference: Under this geographically conditioned and taxon-blocked exploratory fixed-tip null, no source nuclear topology supports clustering of reported U/D characters (small step count). Neither overdispersion nor adaptive repeated origins established.

Mk_CTMC_history.model: ER symmetric versus ARD asymmetric reversible two-state continuous-time Mk with flat 0.5 U/D root prior and tip-trait missing-data integration
Mk_CTMC_history.interpretation: These conditional jump expectations include potentially many hidden U<->D cycles and are hundreds or thousands of percent higher than minimum Fitch changes 8–9. This indicates rate/branch-length saturation and model nonidentifiability, not a real estimate of 96–189 independent adaptive U->D origins.

ecological_next_gate.original_EAzami_hypothesis: U->D associated with higher BIO15 and lower BIO1 along reconstructed present-day tip niche (not ancestral historical climate)
ecological_next_gate.requirements: Increase source-level head states per independent nuclear taxon; improve 53-tip region/genomic-coverage sensitivity and source morphology, build genuine accepted 294-sample nuclear tree and matched taxon present-niche BIO15/BIO1 inputs. Dated paleo branch model separately requires geological reconstructions.

limitations: Only 53 molecular tips/176 loci, 74-locus sensitivity, not Moreyra final 294 BioSample/350 nuclear locus complete worldwide accepted tree.
Three phylogenies reuse same original molecular individuals; not independent biological replication.
27 source taxon-level head traits only; 24 unscored Cirsium molecular samples; original S1 not voucher-photographed phenotype.
All Mk rates use molecular substitutions/site branch lengths, not calendar years; q for reversible model is very high and uncalibrated.
Region-stratified fixed-tip null is exploratory and does not reproduce full species-range spatial autocorrelation or genetic trait dynamics.
No branch-specific historical climate; no adaptive fitness or pollinator mechanism validated.
